answers.question: Which diploma streams are aided and self-financed?
answers.expected: The official Polytechnic site lists 3-year Diploma programs. Self-financing courses include Electrical and Electronics Engineering and Mechanical Engineering. First-year Basic Engineering is common, followed by the allotted branch across six semesters.
